subtopics.title: Human relationships – family – generation gap – young people

outcomes.text: Understand generational differences, family conflicts, relationships between young and older people, and young people’s attitudes towards family life.

subtopics.title: Patterns of daily life – urban and rural life – the media – food and drink – law and order – philosophy and belief – health and fitness

outcomes.text: Understand the media’s role and influence, including the persuasive power of advertising.

subtopics.title: Work and leisure – equality of opportunity – employment and unemployment – sport – free time activities – travel and tourism – education – cultural life/heritage

outcomes.text: Understand preparation for work, employment opportunities, career planning, qualifications, unemployment, declining industries, possible solutions, and immigrant workers.

subtopics.title: War and peace – social and economic development

outcomes.text: Understand the positive and negative effects of social and economic development, including recent developments and predicted future trends.
